glosses: имеющий яйцеобразную, то есть округлую и несколько вытянутую форму

examples.text: Марфуша видит, как в овальные отверстия её маски вплывает растерянная физиономия земского.

glosses: An elongated round shape resembling an egg or ellipse.
A thing having such a shape, such as an arena.
In a projective plane, a set of points such that no three are collinear and there is a unique tangent line at each point.
A sports field, typically but not exclusively oval in shape.
Having the shape of an oval.
Of or pertaining to an ovum.

examples.text: Every congenital abnormality is doubtless due to a peculiarity in the sperm or oval elements or in their mingling, or to some disturbance in their early development.

Representaba el de Écija algunos años más que su primo, y era de regular estatura, de talle largo, de piernas robustas, de pecho arrogante; su rostro oval era de correctas facciones ligeramente acentuadas; su tez, limpia y fresca; su boca, juvenil; sus ojos, grandes y oscuros, de dulce mirar, velados por larguísimas pestañas; su pelo, castaño, rizoso y reluciente.

glosses: Que pertenece o concierne a ovación.
